acceptance: normalize merges adjacent equal runs: given [{0,3,color red},{3,6,color red}] over length 10, expect [{0,6,color red}]

normalize resolves overlaps and clamps: given overlapping red [0,5) and blue [3,8) plus [-2,1) and [8,99) entries over length 9, expect sorted, non-overlapping, clamped to [0,9], later entry wins on overlap
normalize drops empty, inverted and unstyled ranges: given [{2,2,color},{5,3,color},{0,4}], expect []
applyStyle colour inside a highlight keeps the highlight: given highlight yellow [0,10), apply color red to [3,6), expect [{0,3,hl},{3,6,hl+red},{6,10,hl}]
applyStyle clearing both attributes removes the range: given [{2,5,color,highlight}], apply {color:null, highlight:null} to [2,5), expect []
applyStyle with an empty selection is a no-op: given any list, start === end, expect returns the same array instance
shift: insert before a range: given 'abc def' range [4,7), insert 'XX' at 0, expect range [6,9)
shift: insert inside a range extends it: given range [4,7), insert 'X' at 5, expect range [4,8)
shift: insert at range start and end stays unstyled: given range [4,7), insert at 4 and separately at 7, expect [5,8) and [4,7)
shift: insert after a range: given range [0,3), insert at 5, expect [0,3) unchanged
shift: delete inside and spanning a range trims it: given range [2,8), delete [4,6) and separately delete [0,4), expect [2,6) and [0,4)
shift: delete that empties a range drops it: given range [2,4), delete [1,5), expect []
shift: replacement inside a range: given range [0,10), replace [3,5) with 'XYZ', expect [0,11)

split onto wrapped lines with a break inside a styled range: given originalText 'Hello Excalidraw world' wrapped at 100 (break drops a space), red over 'Excalidraw wo', expect each line's run texts concatenate to the line; red runs cover exactly the styled characters on both lines
split keeps hard line breaks: given 'ab\ncd' with highlight over [1,4), expect line 0 runs ['a', 'b'(hl)], line 1 runs ['c'(hl), 'd']

restoreStyleRanges drops invalid entries and clamps: given [{start:'a'},{start:1.5,end:3,color:'red'},{start:0,end:99,color:'red'},null,{start:0,end:2,color:''}] with text length 5, expect [{0,5,color red}]
